universality.scope: canonical positive-shape SwiGLU-MoE Gate, Up and transposed-Down expert frames
source_fitted_values: one transmitted FP32 scale per nonzero N18 record
one transmitted causal arithmetic payload per nonzero N18 record

record.overflow: terminal architecture failure; no seed/profile/transform/topology/retry change
record.logical_eof: hard physical/logical EOF with deterministic virtual-zero arithmetic finalization only
record.integrity: payload SHA-256, payload CRC32, header CRC32, zero terminal/fill bytes
record.zero_tile: zero logical payload, stored scale 1.0, full physical record charged

frame.self_description: every record binds shape, role, tile, valid values and universal seeds
frame.tail: last role tile is shape-prefix plus implicit BF16 +0 padding before RHT; full reservoir charged; compatibility decode only outside exact-rate target cell

numerical.decoder: separately authenticated independent causal decoder; no encoder import
numerical.reconstruction: exact integer inverse signed RHT times eta*FP32_scale/512, exposed as FP32 valid prefix
numerical.residual: original canonical BF16 source minus decoded valid-prefix reconstruction in FP64

read_schedule.decoder_action: sequentially read each record once and buffer decoded symbols/reconstruction for refinement

promotion.first_payload: three authenticated Qwen records: Gate, Up and DownT tile zero
promotion.overflow_gate: any overflow kills the fixed v4 profile with no retry
promotion.full_panel_after_pilot: all 108 records followed by independent decode/re-encode and original-domain score
promotion.claim_boundary: source implementation only; no Qwen, MSE, TACTIC, CAGE, F or target achievement claim
